usage: Opening and background music use YuE2-3B by Multimodal Art Projection, via audio.cpp GGUF. Phrases are mixed with narration, level changes and fades. These demos include CC BY-NC 4.0 music and are for non-commercial use. Retain attribution when sharing.
verification: The Russian demo was regenerated after listening feedback, with targeted development checks and replacement takes. The English demo uses a single take per passage. Neither recording has received complete human listening approval. Original texts are credited at their sources; public-domain status varies by territory.
